design: Evaluate each exact bounded state once. Apply both policies to the same validated answers. Do not change questions, thresholds, or labels after outputs.
promotion: No classification result alone permits promotion. Require zero shortened budgets in normal-required cases, no task correctness or tool-validity regression, and positive paired end-to-end latency improvement including API overhead. Preserve each original result if a candidate changes.
